Lower Text: [When Attacking] Trash the top digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
Upper Text: [Start of Your Main Phase] [On Play] If it's your turn, 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a level 4 Digimon card with the [Angel] or [Free] trait in your hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 1.
